name: preview-card-1g
title: Preview Card 1g: Folder tab
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. The name sits on a tab that rises out of the preview. Nothing sits below it.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
